hand: a view onto bitmap_ (disposal drops it without a write): the write releases the old tiles, resets the presented generation and resource error and republishes before invalidating
properties.name: bitmap
properties.comment: The bitmap shown, shared with the application, or null for none. A new bitmap drops the published tiles and, when attached to a window, publishes the whole bitmap again.

hand: a view: the write goes through set_view with the current origin
properties.name: zoom
properties.comment: Client units per bitmap pixel, 1/64 to 256 (default 1). A value outside that range throws std::invalid_argument and changes nothing; set_view changes zoom and view_origin together.

hand: a view: the write goes through set_view with the current zoom
properties.name: view_origin
properties.comment: The bitmap point shown at the client's top-left corner. A non-finite or unbounded origin throws std::invalid_argument and changes nothing.

properties.name: sampling
properties.comment: How magnified or reduced pixels are sampled (default nearest). A value outside the enumeration throws std::invalid_argument.
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("canvas image sampling is outside the enum");

properties.name: transparency_grid
properties.comment: Whether transparent pixels show a checkerboard (default true).

properties.name: transparency_cell_size
properties.comment: The checkerboard cell size in client units, 2 to 128; zero (the default) selects an adaptive bounded size. Any other value throws std::invalid_argument.
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("canvas transparency cell size must be zero or within [2, 128]");

not_properties.name: view
not_properties.reason: set_view(zoom, origin) is a multi-value call

not_properties.name: transparency_colors
not_properties.reason: set_transparency_colors(first, second) is a multi-value call

not_properties.name: clear_bitmap
not_properties.reason: shorthand for writing a null bitmap
